bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 重回 $388 上方，仍低于 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 1.7% on Nov 17 to $391.26, trading $384.71–394.50. It is below the 10-day ($397.6, falling), 5-day ($397.8), 30-day ($421.7), 200-day ($426.2) and 100-day ($439.0), the longer three falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($432.24), and RSI is 39.7.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月17日上涨 1.7%，收于 $391.26，盘中区间 $384.71–394.50。股价位于 10 日（$397.6，下行）、5 日（$397.8）、30 日（$421.7）、200 日（$426.2）和 100 日均线（$439.0）下方，后三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图平稳；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$432.24），RSI 为 39.7。

read.en: The rebound reclaimed the Nov 10 low ($388.41) and Nov 9 close ($389.36), now support, after the $384.71 low held $383. Resistance is $392.5–395.1 (Nov 6, 16 and 17 highs), then $397.2–398.3 (Nov 10 close, 10 and 5-day, Nov 13 low) and $401.7–402.5. Support is $388.4–389.4, then $383.1–384.7 (Nov 9, 16, 17 lows) and $375.9–378.3. A close above $395.1 would target $398–402; below $383.1, $376–378.
